name: DxSale Legacy Locker repeat-unlock drain
summary: DxLockLPDep.unlockToken() used an if instead of a maturity requirement and never cleared the recorded amount after transfer. A caller with one valid lock could therefore invoke it before maturity and repeatedly withdraw the same allocation from the contract's shared LP-token balance.
notes: The vulnerable lock-maturity, amount-accounting and shared-balance logic is part of the locker's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the exploit.

BlockSec reports approximately $7.3 million drained across the multi-transaction campaign and more than 1,400 LP positions. The anchored transaction is one representative 500-call repeat-withdrawal leg.
The USD amount is BlockSec's rounded campaign estimate across many LP tokens and transactions rather than an independently repriced asset ledger.
